user.title: Set up VEVOR Weatherbridge
user.description: Home Assistant will listen for uploads from your weather station. Point the station's Weather Underground upload at Home Assistant (usually by overriding DNS for `rtupdate.wunderground.com`). The station always uploads to port 80.

data_description.name: Name of the weather station device.
data_description.port: Port to listen on. Keep 80 unless a reverse proxy forwards uploads from port 80.
data_description.station_id: Only accept uploads with this station ID. Leave empty to accept any station.

data_description.port: Port to listen on. Keep 80 unless a reverse proxy forwards uploads from port 80.
data_description.station_id: Only accept uploads with this station ID. Leave empty to accept any station.

error.port_in_use: That port is already in use by another service.
error.port_permission: Home Assistant does not have permission to listen on that port.

abort.already_configured: A weather station is already listening on that port.

data_description.wu_forward: Also send each upload on to Weather Underground, as the station would without the DNS override.
data_description.wu_station_id: Leave empty to use the ID the station sends.
data_description.wu_station_key: Leave empty to use the key the station sends.
